correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no standard for connectivity matrices (BEP017 is in development).

brainlife.desc: Directory of several connectivity matrices (count, density, length) between parcels, e.g. visual areas or retinotopic bins.
brainlife.name: neuro/conmats
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Structural connectivity analysis between visual areas or eccentricity and polar-angle bins.

**Not for:** Apps that expect a single neuro/conmat; the layout differs.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.conmats.json

files.desc: Directory of connectivity matrices, one set per measure.

identifying_risks: Individual connectomes can re-identify a person across datasets (connectome fingerprinting)
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level derivative; step 7 moves fingerprint use to Tier 4.
sharing_cautions: Share with participant codes only, inside a controlled project
tier_conditions: Tier 4 when used or released as connectome fingerprints or to predict traits or behaviour
Tier 1 when averaged across enough participants that no individual can be singled out

intended_use: Structural connectivity analysis between visual areas or eccentricity and polar-angle bins.
not_suitable_for: Apps that expect a single neuro/conmat; the layout differs.

outputs_of.name: Segment structural connections across visual areas
outputs_of.purpose: segments a tractogram into connections between visual areas of a visual-area parcellation

outputs_of.name: Visual areas structural connections by eccentricity and polar angle
outputs_of.purpose: builds polar-angle by eccentricity visual-field parcellations from pRF maps, segments the tractogram
